sentences.ar: ست أشكال للـjoin، بيتطابقوا صف بصف.
sentences.en: Six join shapes, matched row by row.

sentences.ar: الـinner join بيحتفظ بالصفوف اللي طابقت من الناحيتين وبصّ بيعمل إيه هنا.
sentences.en: An inner join keeps rows that matched on both sides — and watch what it does here.

sentences.ar: order 1007 بيشاور على customer 9 اللي مش موجود، فالـinner join بيشيل الـorder كله، وبيعمل كده في الهدوء.
sentences.en: Order ten-oh-seven points at customer 9, who does not exist, so the inner join removes the order entirely, and it does so silently.

sentences.ar: الإجمالي بتاعك بقى غلط وما فيش حاجة حذّرتك.
sentences.en: Your total is now wrong and nothing warned you.

sentences.ar: الـleft join بيحتفظ بيه، وبـnulls على اليمين.
sentences.en: A left join keeps it, with nulls on the right.

sentences.ar: ودلوقتي الـfailure اللي بيضخّم الأرقام في الهدوء في كل مكان.
sentences.en: Now the failure that quietly inflates numbers across the industry.

sentences.ar: ست عملاء داخلين. خمستاشر صف خارجين.
sentences.en: Six customers go in. Fifteen rows come out.

sentences.ar: إن الخارج أكتر من الداخل ده اسمه fan-out، وبيحصل كل ما الـkey اللي عملت عليه join ما يكونش unique في الناحية التانية.
sentences.en: More rows out than in is called fan-out, and it happens whenever the key you joined on is not unique on the other side.

sentences.ar: الـgrain اتغيّر في الهدوء من صف لكل عميل لصف لكل order، فأي رقم على مستوى العميل هتجمعه بقى بيعدّ Amara أربع مرات.
sentences.en: The grain silently changed from one row per customer to one row per order, so any customer-level number you sum now counts Amara four times.

sentences.ar: وكل SUM بعد كده بقت أكبر من الحقيقة.
sentences.en: Every downstream SUM is larger than the truth.

sentences.ar: الـGROUP BY بتنهار الصفوف؛ والـwindow function بتحسب عبر partition وبترجّع كل الصفوف.
sentences.en: GROUP BY collapses rows; a window function computes across a partition and still returns every row.

sentences.ar: بصّ على حدود الـpartition وعلى الـframe اللي الـfunction شايفاه فعلاً، وهو بيزحف صف بصف.
sentences.en: Watch the partition boundary and the frame the function can actually see, sliding one row at a time.

sentences.ar: ولما قيمتين يتساووا، ROW_NUMBER برضه بيخترع ترتيب وده بالظبط سبب إنك بتعمل dedupe بـROW_NUMBER مش بـRANK.
sentences.en: When two values tie, ROW_NUMBER still invents an order — which is exactly why you deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER and not with RANK.

sentences.ar: وأخيراً الـnulls. الـNULL مش قيمة، دي غياب قيمة، فمقارنتها بأي حاجة بترجّع غير معروف، مش false.
sentences.en: And finally, nulls. NULL is not a value, it is the absence of one, so comparing it to anything returns unknown, not false.

sentences.ar: وNOT IN على مجموعة فيها null واحد بترجّع ولا صف خالص بشكل صحيح، وكارثي.
sentences.en: NOT IN against a set containing a single null returns no rows at all — correctly, and catastrophically.

glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.

concepts.def_en: Combines rows from two tables by matching key columns, such as orders with their customer…
concepts.failure: Joining on a non-unique key silently multiplies rows and inflates totals.

concepts.def_en: A marker meaning a value is missing or unknown, not zero or an empty string; comparing wi…
concepts.failure: Using = NULL instead of IS NULL, so rows with missing values silently disappear.

concepts.def_en: A join returning more rows than went in, because the join key is not unique on the other side.
concepts.def_ar: لما الـjoin يرجّع صفوف أكتر من الداخلة، لأن الـkey اللي عملنا بيه join مش unique في الناحية التانية.
concepts.failure: Summing after a join without checking key uniqueness, silently inflating totals.

concepts.def_en: What exactly one row represents, such as one order line; every metric must be computed at…
concepts.failure: Computing a SUM at the wrong grain, getting a confident but wrong number.

concepts.def_en: SQL clause that splits rows into groups sharing the same key values, so aggregates like S…
concepts.failure: Grouping on a dirty key, so one customer splits into many groups.

concepts.def_en: Computes across a set of related rows, a partition, while still returning every row, unlike GROUP BY which collapses them.
concepts.def_ar: بتحسب عبر مجموعة صفوف مرتبطة (partition) من غير ما تدمج الصفوف، عكس GROUP BY اللي بيدمجها.
concepts.failure: Forgetting PARTITION BY, so the window spans the whole table.

concepts.def_en: A slice of data split by key or range, so work touches only part of it; in window functio…
concepts.failure: Choosing a partition key queries never filter on, so nothing is pruned.

concepts.def_en: A named, reusable block of code that takes inputs, does a calculation and returns a value.
concepts.failure: Forgetting return, so the function silently gives back None.
